text: Week 74 - Coaching_Jenny_Huda_Wk74_2024-07-24_M_f6ce7c4940bc2491U_2024-07-23_00-00-00 00:33:17 huda: Meet the EmpowHER Hacks winner, Aditi Ranjan! The past weekend, Empowering AI had the privilege to platform tech pioneers such as Aditi to create technologies that advocated or contributed to the solution of gender-based discrimination and inequity in the STEM field. Aditi’s project was selected from 100+ competitors from 40+ cities. In 27 hours, Aditi developed “CodeHER,” an innovative coding platform designed specifically for women. Our talented judges, , were specifically impressed by features such as a multilingual AI-powered Code Coach, a comprehensive resource hub in Code Library, and a community-driven showcase of talented coders in Code Stars. Aditi’s development of CodeHER was no small feat, especially within 27 hours! As opposed to “just another hackathon project,” CodeHER is a testament to the great thing women in tech can pioneer. This is Empowering AI’s greatest pride— platforming women like Aditi to code the future. 00:53:19 Jenny Duan: https://www.myna.org/new-page-68 00:54:47 Jenny Duan: https://www.myna.org/podcast
